RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 30
Raising the panel’s gender composition without concrete evidence of bias is professionally risky and legally ungrounded. An all-female panel is not proof of discrimination.

For a group head role, commercial acumen, leadership style, and client relationships are frequently prioritized over sheer technical tenure. The successful candidate met the chartered requirement and offered demonstrated client-facing strengths, which are critical for executive positions.

Accusing the panel of bias based solely on demographics will damage your reputation and alienate industry contacts. Instead, follow up politely on your request for constructive feedback. Inquire specifically about the competencies that separated the candidates to gain actionable insights without burning bridges.
